tip_pool_get_available_tips.label: Get Available Tips
tip_pool_get_available_tips.description: Return the available tip positions for a tip pool.

tip_pool_get_empty_tips.label: Get Empty Tips
tip_pool_get_empty_tips.description: Return the empty tip positions for a tip pool.

tip_pool_get_missing_racks.label: Get Missing Racks
tip_pool_get_missing_racks.description: Return missing tip racks for a tip pool.

tip_pool_get_tip_counter.label: Get Tip Counter
tip_pool_get_tip_counter.description: Return the tip counter state for the specified tip pool.

tip_pool_get_tip_counters.label: Get All Tip Counters
tip_pool_get_tip_counters.description: Return the tip counter state for every tip pool.

tip_pool_initialize_tip_counter.label: Initialize Tip Counter
tip_pool_initialize_tip_counter.description: Initialize the tip counter for a tip pool.

tip_pool_reset_tip_counter.label: Reset Tip Counter
tip_pool_reset_tip_counter.description: Reset the tip counter for the specified tip pool.

tip_pool_set_tip_counter.label: Set Tip Counter
tip_pool_set_tip_counter.description: Directly set the per-slot tip state for a tip pool.

tip_pool_show_tip_counter.label: Show Tip Counter
tip_pool_show_tip_counter.description: Show the tip counter dialog for the specified tip pool.

tip_pool_show_tip_counters.label: Show Tip Counters
tip_pool_show_tip_counters.description: Show the tip counter dialog for the specified tip pools, or every tip pool if omitted.

tip_pools.label: Tip Pools
tip_pools.help: Leave empty to show every tip pool
